The company will issue 34M units at C$0.05 each for aggregate gross proceeds of C$1.7M.
Each unit comprises one common share and one warrant, with each warrant exercisable at C$0.10 per share for three years from closing.
Gold Fields Atacama, a wholly owned affiliate of Gold Fields Limited, is contributing C$170,191.20 to the financing.
Gold Fields' participation increases its ownership of Torq to 10.95%.
Torq plans to use the net proceeds for general working capital.
